description: This PHP class, HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector, is responsible for collecting, managing, and formatting error messages related to HTML purification. It provides methods to add errors, retrieve raw error data, and generate HTML-formatted reports of the errors, supporting detailed error structures and localization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector
classes.description: Class for collecting and formatting errors during HTML purification, supporting error hierarchy and localization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error collector with a given context, setting up localization, errors array, and error stacks.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Adds an error message with severity, message text, and contextual information to the collector.

methods.name: getRaw
methods.description: Returns the raw array of collected errors.

methods.name: getHTMLFormatted
methods.description: Generates an HTML formatted string summarizing the collected errors, optionally recursive over error structures.

methods.name: _renderStruct
methods.description: Recursively renders error structures into HTML strings for display.
